claim_verdicts.source: Chrome 153 headless via CDP, reviewer scratch run on git show stage-0:www/*.html served from 127.0.0.1:8099; no HTML/MDN docs root in versions.yaml, none under refs/
claim_verdicts.evidence: T2: two buttons added to index.html; handler 1 sets h1 text then busy-waits 3 s; button 2 clicked 0.5 s later. Page log: `h1 start 836`, `h1 end 3835`, `rAF (render step) 3838`, `h2 start 3839`. The second click was queued, not lost, and its handler started only after the first returned: one task at a time, each to completion. Observed in Chrome only; the single 'queue' is the simplification depth_notes allow.

claim_verdicts.source: examples/don-hang @ stage-1: scripts/up.sh:12; refs/flutter-website sites/docs/src/content/perf/isolates.md 'Web platforms and compute'; pub.dev/packages/http (1.6.0)
claim_verdicts.evidence: up.sh:12 `(cd DonHang.App && flutter build web >/dev/null)`. isolates.md: "Dart web platforms, including Flutter web, don't support isolates." ... "The compute() method runs the computation on the main thread on the web". pub.dev http (r1 fetch): "By default, package:http uses BrowserClient on the web". So the app's Dart runs on the page's main thread and its requests go through the browser.

issues.quote: Picks the next waiting task and runs it before any other
issues.text: q1 option a (key) lost the run-to-completion part: 'runs it before any other' reads as priority over other tasks, not 'lets it finish before starting another'. Still the only defensible option, so the key stands; the wording is weaker than §3/§4 and explanation.correct ('each to completion').
issues.fix: Option a en: "Picks the next waiting task and lets it finish before starting another"; vi: "Chọn task đang chờ tiếp theo và để nó chạy xong rồi mới bắt đầu task khác".

issues.quote: The browser has many threads for its own work, but a page's handlers run on one thread
issues.text: q2 explanation.correct (en and vi 'Trình duyệt có nhiều thread cho việc riêng của nó') still asserts 'many threads', the wording r1 rephrased out of claim 4 and §6 as unsupportable. Key c remains correct.
issues.fix: en: "The browser does some work outside the page's thread, but a page's handlers run on one thread; a second click waits until the first handler returns." vi: "Trình duyệt làm một số việc bên ngoài thread của trang, nhưng handler của trang chạy trên một thread; cú bấm thứ hai chờ tới khi handler đầu trả về."

issues.quote: On a shop's page, you click "Calculate total".
issues.text: Carried over from round 1: the scene is a generic shop page, not a moment in Đơn Hàng, and §5 says the lab pages have no JavaScript, so this button is not in the system I know. The closing question is still answered by §4, so the section works.
issues.fix: Anchor the scene in one phrase, e.g. 'On an order page like the one the Đơn Hàng app will have, you click "Calculate total".'

issues.quote: Holding the thread would happen only when the request were a wait that held the page's thread, but the browser does the waiting outside it.
issues.text: q4 explanation b explains 'holding the thread' with 'a wait that held the page's thread': it says the same thing twice and I learn nothing new from it. Explanation d ('would be needed only when the waiting were done by JavaScript') is also hard to parse on first read. The key (a) is clear from §4/§5, so this does not block me.
issues.fix: Explanation b: 'A request does not hold the page's thread: the browser does the waiting outside it, so clicks and drawing carry on.' Explanation d: 'No second page thread is started; the browser waits on its own and the page keeps one JavaScript thread.'
